7.19.2 PDU channel modes
CanIf
provides the services
CanIf_SetPduMode()
and
CanIf_GetPduMode()
to
prevent the processing of
•
all
Transmit L-PDUs
belonging to one logical channel,
•
all
Transmit L-PDUs
and
Receive L-PDUs
belonging to one logical channel.
Changing the PDU channel mode is only allowed in case corresponding controller
mode equals
CAN_CS_STARTED
(refer to [SWS_CANIF_00874]).
